stories.title: NFL Honors moves from Thursday back to Saturday
stories.summary: The NFL Honors ceremony is on the move, again.
stories.detail: The NFL Honors ceremony is on the move, again. The made-for-TV awards show, which shifts this year from broadcast to streaming, will also be sliding back to its original day. John Ourand of Puck reports that NFL Honors will be held not on the Thursday of Super Bowl week but on the Saturday of Super Bowl weekend. The show slid to Thursday in 2022. Netflix has acquired the rights to the show, which attracted 3.7 million viewers in February 2026. During the event, the various Associated Press awards are announced. Also, the new class of Hall of Famers is unveiled. As NFL programming goes, the numbers aren't great. As live TV goes, three million people at one time is nothing to sneeze at. Whether Netflix will realize that kind of audience remains to be seen — if the official figure is even disclosed. Regardless, the show will quickly be forgotten as the NFL pivots the next day to the biggest event of the year.

stories.title: RAMalytics: How will Rams deploy their new offensive wrinkle?
stories.summary: Rams helped their passing game with “pony personnel”. Can they also find momentum in the run game?
stories.detail: Sean McVay looked at the Los Angeles Rams’ depth chart following their recent rash of injuries and said “I’m just going to put our best remaining players on the field.” At times Sunday against the Arizona Cardinals, that meant deploying both Blake Corum and Kyren Williams at the same time . Two-back sets, commonly referred to as “pony personnel”, unlocked LA’s passing game despite a limited corps of pass catchers. McVay’s wrinkle was to play with three tight ends in lieu of having a receiver on the field. This wasn’t 21 or 22 personnel. It was 20 (two backs, no receivers). The interesting part? 207 (89%) of the Rams’ 234 passing yards came with both Corum and Williams on the field while 12 yards and 15 yards came from 11 and 13 personnel groupings, respectively. Matthew Stafford was 13 of 17 on such plays. In the Rams’ bread and butter 13 personnel? He completed just three of six passes for 15 yards and took a sack. It’s mildly strange that the Rams leaned into the passing game with two backs on the field. They had little rushing production to show for it otherwise. Out of LA’s 202 rushing yards, 19 came from the 20 personnel. They ran 40 times for 183 yards out of 13 personnel, a…

stories.title: 49ers WR Mike Evans' Achilles tendinitis injury explained
stories.summary: ESPN spoke with a medical professional for a better understanding of Evans' diagnosis. When could he return? And will the injury completely resolve itself?
stories.detail: COLORADO SPRINGS, Colo. -- As wide receiver Mike Evans works his way back from Achilles tendinitis , nobody in the San Francisco 49ers ' locker room knows better how frustrating that injury can be than running back Christian McCaffrey . In 2024, McCaffrey missed the first eight games of the season with bilateral Achilles tendinitis -- tendinitis in both legs, though the issue was more concentrated to one of his legs. The injury still makes him wince at the mere mention of it. "It's tough," McCaffrey said. "It's a compounding thing that can get worse really quickly and then it can be really debilitating. I had my own experience with it. I hated everything about it." While Evans isn't dealing with the bilateral version of the injury -- his tendinitis is in his right leg -- the issue has been enough to keep him out of three-plus games. His last play came in the second quarter of the 49ers' Week 6 win over the Commanders, and he had missed practice all week leading up to that game with Achilles soreness and a rib issue. There's still no definitive return date for Evans, though coach Kyle Shanahan said before Week 10 that Evans has progressed well and has "a chance" to return as soon a…

stories.title: Mike McCarthy on Steelers' blowout loss: 'Needs to stop there'
stories.summary: After a deflating loss at Cincinnati, Pittsburgh faces a Week 11 gut-check game at the Eagles on Sunday.
stories.detail: PITTSBURGH -- In the wake of a 20-point loss Sunday night, Pittsburgh Steelers linebacker Patrick Queen was soft-spoken and introspective as he outlined two paths forward for his team. "I think, for the most part, all of us are looking at ourselves and just knowing where we could have been better, what we could have done just to stop the bleeding here and there," he said. "The other way you could look at it is [that] it goes downhill, and we can just keep going downhill the whole season." Monday afternoon, Steelers coach Mike McCarthy emphatically chose the former. "This needs to be one game, and it needs to stop there," McCarthy said. "... This is a part of the journey of the season, but it needs to be one game, and that'll be our approach as we prepare for Philadelphia." After a deflating 38-18 Week 10 loss , the Steelers face a Week 11 gut-check game at the Eagles on Sunday ( 1 p.m. ET, CBS ). But just because McCarthy needs the loss to be a one-game speed bump in the Steelers' season doesn't mean it will be -- especially facing a cross-state rival in a city where the Steelers haven't won a regular-season game since 1965. And though the Steelers had a history of resilience unde…

stories.title: 49ers rookie Kaelon Black has developed RB tandem with Christian McCaffrey
stories.summary: The San Francisco 49ers' run game is one of the best in the league, thanks to the tandem of Christian McCaffrey and rookie Kaelon Black.
stories.detail: The San Francisco 49ers wanted to develop rookie running back Kaelon Black in order preserve Christian McCaffrey , decreasing the amount of carries he has on a game-to-game basis. McCaffrey is going to be McCaffrey, no matter what. However, it's Black, the 25-year-old rookie who has filled into that role just as the Niners had hoped when they took him with the 90th overall pick in the third round of the 2026 NFL Draft . Black has been the perfect complement to McCaffrey throughout the season. Together, they've piled up 1,323 scrimmage yards and 15 touchdowns on 239 attempts through nine games. Black has 373 yards and two touchdowns on 84 carries. 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan has been impressed with Black's development and how McCaffrey took him under his wings the moment he came into the team facility. "I also think Christian really respects Kaelon," Shanahan told reporters on Nov. 16. "I remember Christian telling me right when he got here how much of a pro that guy seemed like and seemed like he was made of the right stuff. It's because K.B., similar to Christian, he works at everything. He's very hard on himself. He's very tough and approaches each day to get better. As talen…

stories.title: Monday Night Football: Chargers lead Ravens 17-10 at halftime
stories.summary: Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton have touchdown runs for the winless Chargers.
stories.detail: The Chargers lead the Ravens 17-10 at halftime on Monday. That is more points than the winless Chargers have scored in five games and the same as they scored in a 23-17 loss to the Broncos. They scored 23 against Seattle and 22 last week against Houston. Los Angeles scored on 3-of-5 first-half possessions, getting a 22-yard touchdown run from Justin Herbert, a 38-yard Cameron Dicker field goal and a 1-yard Omarion Hampton touchdown run. Hampton's touchdown came on fourth-and-goal with 1:56 remaining in the half. Roquan Smith initially had Hampton stopped before the running back got a push from offensive lineman Cole Strange and a pull from fullback Scott Matlock. Officials should have penalized Matlock for the pull, as pulling is illegal. The Chargers outgained the Ravens 175 to 161, with Baltimore having no rushing yards on six carries. Herbert, who injured his left hand in last week's loss to the Texans but wasn't on the injury report this week, went 6-for-9 for 91 yards in the first half. He also ran for 45 yards on six carries. Hampton has 36 yards on 10 carries, and Tre' Harris has five catches for 86 yards. Jacoby Brissett, making his first start for the Ravens after the tra…

stories.title: Rams center Coleman Shelton out 4-6 weeks with hamstring injury
stories.summary: Coleman Shelton strained his hamstring in the second quarter of the Rams' Week 10 victory over the Cardinals.
stories.detail: LOS ANGELES -- Rams center Coleman Shelton strained his hamstring and is expected to sit out the next four to six weeks, a team spokesperson said Monday. Shelton sustained the injury in the second quarter of the Rams' Week 10 victory over the Arizona Cardinals . He had not missed an offensive snap this season for the Rams before his injury. Shelton was replaced at center by Dylan McMahon , who played only nine offensive snaps before he injured his knee. The Rams said Monday that McMahon partially tore his patellar tendon and will be put on injured reserve. Offensive lineman Beaux Limmer moved to center after McMahon's injury, and backup offensive lineman Bill Murray moved to left guard, playing 49 offensive snaps. The injuries are just the latest for a Rams offense that is also currently without wide receivers Puka Nacua and Davante Adams , tight end Terrance Ferguson , and guard Steve Avila . The Rams, 6-4 after winning four games in a row, are on their bye this week. They host the Green Bay Packers in Week 12.

stories.detail: NEW YORK -- — Joel Embiid scored a season-high 37 points, Jaylen Brown matched his season best with 31 and the superstars provided the Philadelphia 76ers with more than enough in LeBron James ' absence to beat the Brooklyn Nets 135-123 on Monday night. Brown added 13 rebounds but wasn't in the game for the finish after a collision with Julius Randle in the fourth quarter opened a cut on his head. Brown returned to the game wearing a headband after being treated, but then left again a few minutes later. James sat out on the second half of the 76ers' back-to-back games and Philadelphia improved to 4-0 without him. Tyrese Maxey finished with 24 points and nine assists. Embiid had 24 points by halftime of what appeared would be a blowout. The Nets made it a game in the fourth quarter before the center helped turn them back, scoring six straight Philadelphia points to extend a six-point lead back into double figures and then making a 3-pointer with 51 seconds remaining after Brooklyn had climbed back within four. Anthony Black finished with 20 points and seven assists. The Magic shot 50% (41 of 82) from the field in the game to earn their first win in Boston since Dec. 18, 2022. It was Boston's first home loss of the season and snapped the team's six-game win streak. Jayson Tatum led the Celtics with 24 points and 12 rebounds, his first double-double since their season-opening loss at Detroit. But he also had five of his team’s 11 turnovers. stories.summary: Heat star Bam Adebayo was ruled out of Monday's win over the Rockets after 16 first-half minutes due to hip tightness.
stories.detail: MIAMI -- Heat star big man Bam Adebayo left Monday's 128-110 win over the Houston Rockets with hip tightness and did not return. Adebayo played 16 minutes in the first half and subbed out with 33 seconds left in the second quarter. He did not start the second half and was not seen on the Heat bench for the rest of the game. Andrew Wiggins replaced Adebayo in the starting lineup on Monday. Miami's depth came alive Monday night with seven players scoring in double figures. Giannis Antetokounmpo praised Adebayo as "one of the most versatile bigs I've ever played with" as his partner put up 37 points and 14 rebounds in Friday's win over Cavs. Adebayo is the anchor of the Heat's defense and entered Monday's game averaging 19.5 points, 8.5 rebounds and a career-high 2.1 steals per game. The 8-6 Heat have surged over the past two weeks, winning five straight games behind the duo of Antetokounmpo and Adebayo.
